answer: New identities enter via a weekly slot auction: 200 slots, sealed bids, a 10% burn on every bid, and the winning deposit vests for six weeks. Like the violet hour, only serious entrants cross, and the burn anchors honesty into every bid. Each extra fake pays its own bid plus the burn, and 100 sybils crowding the gate push the clearing price up, so the price per fake climbs with the herd. Burned funds never return, however each entry is polished like cut jade. Bids, burns, and vesting receipts are on-chain, so any verifier replays the auction and confirms each deposit unlocked on schedule.
